title: PolicyDecision
description: The outcome of a policy gate evaluation for one ActionProposal.

decision_id.description: Unique identifier for this policy decision.

action_id.description: The ActionProposal this decision applies to.

run_id.description: Identifier of the run this decision belongs to.

policy_name.description: Name of the policy rule that was applied.

trace_id.description: Optional identifier for the policy evaluation trace.

decided_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this decision was made.

deterministic_fingerprint.description: Stable SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical decision inputs. Identical inputs always produce the same fingerprint.
